metric_definitions.log_loss: mean negative log actual-state probability after 1e-9 clipping and row renormalization
metric_definitions.brier: mean three-state sum squared probability error
metric_definitions.normalized_entropy_sharpness: one minus mean forecast entropy divided by log(3); zero is uniform and one is degenerate
metric_definitions.state_recall: argmax true positives divided by actual support for each state
metric_definitions.transition_event: actual next state differs from current state at the forecast origin
metric_definitions.transition_detection_delay: matched weekly forecast steps from an actual transition target until the first argmax prediction of its destination, censored at the next actual transition
metric_definitions.false_alarm: argmax predicts departure from current state while the actual next state remains current
metric_definitions.false_alarms_per_year: false alarm count divided by n_predictions/52.1775
